test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Parvathy explained that she was playing the violin.

options.text: “I am playing the violin,” Parvathy explained.

solution:
The correct answer is option (2). [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech. 'Parvathy' is the speaker. Parvathy is talking about herself.
 
• That's why in the direct speech 'she' will change into **'I'**.
 
• When we convert indirect speech to direct speech the reported speech will come under a double inverted comma.
 
• After the reporting speech, there will be a comma and 'That' will be removed.
